verdict.rationale: Fern's scheduled Fern Agent automations open pull requests against the docs source repository, so their changes go through Git-based review (fern-docs-8, fern-docs-25, fern-docs-29). Rollback of those changes is only implied by the Git workflow. Nothing shows the automation definitions themselves being versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The docs 'Versions' feature is for content releases, not automations. Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions/prompts, explicit rollback of automations or their runs, review/approval workflow for automation configs, independent corroboration.
